name: glyphfit
description: On-demand image downscaling for Claude vision. Prefix Read's file_path with `shrink:` and the image is resized so the smallest glyph still fits the readable floor — keep text legible, shed pixels.

outlier_percentile.title: Outlier percentile
outlier_percentile.description: Drop the bottom N% of detected character-box heights as outliers/noise. The smallest remaining height becomes the scaling basis. Range 1–50, recommended 5–10.

floor_char_height_px.title: Floor character height (px)
floor_char_height_px.description: Minimum line height for the smallest non-outlier character in the output. Recommended: 12 (latin only), 18 (hangul/kana, default), 24 (simplified CJK), 32 (traditional CJK). Lower = more aggressive shrink.

min_pixels_for_action.title: Bypass under N pixels
min_pixels_for_action.description: Images smaller than this pixel count are passed through unchanged.

enabled.title: Enable auto-shrink
enabled.description: When false, Read calls pass through without modification.
